summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Emacs and Elpaca.

values.language_tooling_setup: Start the supplied `emacs` wrapper with the configuration’s `--init-directory`. It loads the pinned Elpaca manager before user initialization and activates readonly Nix-built packages through the native package queue. Source and documentation navigation use those pinned sources; caches, aliases and editor state remain private.
